description: Vampito (the mosquitopire sculpt under the vampito name; artist 2026-09-25). Neither source blend (newunit-mosquitopire / newunit-vampito) carries a material or colour attribute and no Conquest glb exists for either, so there are no shipped RGBs to carry: this is the first authored look, built on the lane brief's read of a vampire mosquito - pale ashen body and head, a blood-engorged abdomen, deep crimson bat-wing membranes, a near-black cape collar behind the head, blood-red eyes and proboscis tip. No emission: the source has no glow.

body.note: thorax + chest ball - pale ashen (vampire pallor, faint lilac)

abdomen.note: the segmented hanging abdomen - engorged with blood

wing_arm.note: wing leading-edge arms - pale bone, a step darker than the body

talon.note: the hanging wing hands below TALON_Z - dark talons

membrane.note: wing membranes between arm and hand - deep crimson bat-wing / cape

collar.note: the spiky mane behind the head - near-black cape collar

eyes.note: eye spheres - blood red (not emissive: the source has no glow)

proboscis_tip.note: the outer PROB_TIP_LEN of the proboscis - blood-stained tip
